name: decision-brief
title: Application decision brief
for_each: select id,reference as name from portfolio.applications where lifecycle<>'retired' order by reference

sections.title: Consumers to consult
sections.sql: select a.reference,a.name,a.owner,d.kind,d.evidence from portfolio.dependencies d join portfolio.applications a on a.id=d.consumer_id where d.provider_id=$1 and d.status='active' and a.lifecycle<>'retired'

sections.title: Decisions and evidence
sections.note: Internal record only. This document does not stop a service or cancel a subscription.
sections.sql: select action,status,rationale,evidence,due_on,approved_by from portfolio.decisions where application_id=$1 order by created_at

name: evidence-review
title: Application evidence review
for_each: select id,reference as name from portfolio.applications where personal_data is distinct from false order by reference

sections.title: Evidence supplied by the operator
sections.sql: select kind,evidence,reviewed_on,review_due,actor from portfolio.controls where application_id=$1 order by kind

sections.title: Items to review
sections.note: NZ privacy Principles 5 and 9 and AU APP 11 guide these evidence prompts. They do not certify legal compliance.
sections.sql: select c.kind,c.rule,c.finding,c.review_due from portfolio.compliance c join portfolio.applications a on a.reference=c.reference where a.id=$1

name: renewal-brief
title: Application renewal brief
for_each: select id,reference as name from portfolio.applications where lifecycle<>'retired' and renewal_on is not null order by reference

sections.title: Review decisions
sections.note: The renewal date is not a cancellation deadline. Consult the signed terms.
sections.sql: select action,status,rationale,evidence,due_on from portfolio.decisions where application_id=$1 order by due_on
